meta.source: Hybrid Solutions Brand Manual (Varumärkesmanual, 2022) and brand asset files supplied by Andreas Lindstedt
meta.derived: Colours gray-*, surface*, text*, border*, focus-ring, the status colours, and all spacing and radius tokens are derived for internal apps (approved by Andreas 2026-10-14), not from the brand files.

tokens.name: ocean
tokens.usage: Main colour (Main Ocean, Pantone 2767 C). Brand book: HEX 1D2542. White text on it: 15.05:1. Use for headers, primary surfaces and headings on white.

tokens.name: electric
tokens.usage: Secondary colour (Secondary Electric). RGB 0, 153, 212 / HEX #0099D4, confirmed by Andreas (the manual prints Merlot's values for Electric). CMYK 100, 28, 0, 17: CALCULATED with the same RGB-to-CMYK formula that reproduces the manual's CMYK for Ocean, Poppy, Merlot and Charcoal exactly; not printed in the manual. Pantone: unknown; nearest candidates 299 C, 2191 C and 2925 C are about equally close and none matches exactly. Ocean text on it: 4.66:1 (passes AA). White text on it: 3.23:1, large text (24px+ or 18.66px bold) only.

tokens.name: poppy
tokens.usage: Secondary colour (Secondary Poppy, Pantone Orange 021 C). White text on it: 3.41:1 and Ocean text on it: 4.41:1, both below AA for normal text: use only for large text (24px+ or 18.66px bold), graphics and accents. The manual states its swatch text colours meet AA; this pair measures 4.41:1.

tokens.name: merlot
tokens.usage: Supporting colour (Supporting Merlot, Pantone 7420 C). White text on it: 7.57:1. The manual lists the same Pantone (7420 C) for Electric, which looks like a copy error.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Text colour (Text Charcoal, Pantone Black C). Body text on white: 13.81:1.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Page background and the inverted logo. Text on Ocean, Merlot and Charcoal.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Black logo version only (manual p.6: Logotyp i svart). Use Charcoal for text.

gradient.note: Two gradients from manual p.13. Endpoints are the brand colours; direction as drawn on the colour page (first colour at top). The supplied backgrounds run the other way (Electric/Poppy at top).

tokens.name: gradient-merlot-poppy
